newsitem.title: USA: U.S. BARGE RATES - RATES THINLY QUOTED IN NEARBYS.
newsitem.headline: U.S. BARGE RATES - RATES THINLY QUOTED IN NEARBYS.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were thinly quoted Tuesday for nearby positions on St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Monday.
- One barge, Mount Vernon, Ind., Ohio River, this week, bid 105 percent, no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, next week, bid 130 percent, down five percentage points from Monday, offer 140 percent, unchanged from Monday.
- Two barges, St Paul-Savage, Upper Mississippi, next week, bid 160 percent of tariff, down five percentage points from Monday, no offer.
- One barge, Spring Valley, Illinois River, on station, no bid, offer 107-1/2 percent, no comparison.
